description:
An activation preset of a Charter Pack (presets/<id>.yaml), in the sanitized shape of ADR-0042.

A preset selects artifacts of any activatable kind, mission types, skills and glossary packs included (one kind model, IC-20; decision DM-01M6RCY40CQQTHC130RWF43W0D): applying it sets selected.<kind> of the activation document for each kind it lists. Each item may carry the must-have mark; the marked items are the preset's required set (ADR-0031, operator ruling on #195), and a preset with any must-have item is a governing preset. Every activation list holds at least one item: a kind the preset does not select is left out. There is no kind gate: the key activated_kinds is not part of the shape, so a preset carrying it is refused when its pack is registered. Legacy required_<plural> keys are not part of the shape.
